debit.notes: Loss/theft/misuse: report immediately on the bank's 24X7 Toll Free Customer Care lines; the contact page states customer care executives are available 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM while 'Emergency Services are available 24/7 for Blocking card/UPI'. Mobile Banking App: Menu > My Cards > Debit > select the card > 'Card Lock', then authenticate with the OTP sent to your registered mobile number; Internet Banking (retail.sbm.bank.in/mfmbs/ib/login.jsp) follows the same path. App 'SBM Bank India Ltd' — store links published on the bank's SBM Mobile page. The bank's pages carry the national cybercrime notice 'DIAL 1930 FOR ONLINE FINANCIAL FRAUD. REPORT ANY CYBERCRIME AT WWW.CYBERCRIME.GOV.IN'. No SMS block keyword and no overseas helpline number is published on sbm.bank.in; customercare@sbmbank.co.in is the bank's published general Email Support, not a 24x7 block channel.

credit.notes: The bank's block page covers credit cards explicitly: 'Immediately report the loss/theft/misuse of your Credit/Debit Card on the Bank's 24X7 Toll Free Customer Care Help Line no. 1800 2099 335 or 1800 1033 817' (executives 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM; emergency blocking 24/7). SBM credit cards are FD-backed/secured co-branded cards (SBM MobiKwik First, SBM ZET, SBM Kredit.Pe, SBM novio, SBM Magnet, Niyo SBM Global, SBM OneCard, SBM Paisabazaar Step-Up, Paisabazaar Paisa Plus); the app/netbanking Card Lock steps on the block page are published for debit cards only, so no credit self-block path is published. Credit-card line 18002681199 and mailbox creditcard@sbmbank.co.in are published for card cancellation ('Cancel my Credit Card', or Partner app > Manage Cards > 'Cancel Credit Card') and mis-selling/harassment complaints (cardsalescomplaints@sbmbank.co.in) — not for blocking. No SMS block keyword and no overseas helpline number is published.

upi.notes: UPI blocking is by phone: sbm.bank.in/contact-us states "Emergency Services are available 24/7 for Blocking card/UPI Freezing account Reporting unauthorised transactions" — call the Toll Free Help Line 1800 2099 335 / 1800 1033 817 (customer care executives 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM; emergency line 24/7). UPI Terms & Conditions clause 4.10 puts suspension on request: "It is the sole responsibility of the User to request the Bank, to suspend the said Facility due to change of his registered Mobile Phone Number or if his Mobile Phone has been lost or has been allotted to some other person" — no self-service UPI on/off toggle, netbanking UPI-manage path, SMS keyword or *99# is published on sbm.bank.in. Mobile app "SBM Bank India Ltd" (store links published on the bank's sbm-mobile page); its published feature list (NEFT/IMPS/RTGS transfers, FD/RD, bills) mentions no UPI management.
